scope: Complete original JSON graph builder view/list/typed option/index and entity runtime view/copy/read/debug methods. Thin append-only bridges expose private methods without reconstructing their implementation. Original file prefixes and registry checksums preserved.
controls: Nine installation/replacement/clear/list/plain/selected-ID/invalid-ID patterns; equal/different/max-u64 views, zero/nonzero IDs, JSON/ordinary index modes, table override and shared/independent ledgers. Full lookups and diagnostics.
source_behaviors: Only JSON read graphs materialize the option identity index; ordinary relation options are unindexed.
Repeated selected valid identities at the same view/type mark the index ambiguous even if the same edge key is written again.
Replacing an edge with a different ID leaves original edge-key lookup behavior intact; the observer does not repair or normalize it.
Ordinary table entries take priority across every view.
JSON list storage retains list facets but does not populate the separate relation facet index; ordinary list storage does.
Fresh/shared/loaded view copies preserve the original coordinate and ledger separation rules.
remaining: Actual JSON parsing, metadata capability validation and typed JSON graph decoder assembly; dynamic fields, SQL/privacy, generated APIs and complete configurations remain open.
